import pandas as pd
pd.set_option('display.width', 250)
df = pd.read_csv('data.csv')

key = ['csp','cloud_service','application','instance_family']
# rows per day per key
g = df.groupby(key+['date']).agg(price=('price','first'), n=('num_instances','first'), cost=('unblended_cost','sum'), exp=('expiration_date','first')).reset_index()

# pivot cost
piv = g.pivot_table(index=key, columns='date', values='cost')
pre = piv.loc[:, '2025-09-01':'2025-10-19'].mean(axis=1)
post = piv.loc[:, '2025-10-20':'2025-11-09'].mean(axis=1)
res = pd.DataFrame({'pre':pre,'post':post,'on':piv['2025-10-20']})
res['delta'] = res['post']-res['pre']
res['d_on'] = res['on']-res['pre']
print(res.sort_values('delta', ascending=False).head(20).to_string())
print()

dates = sorted(df['date'].unique())
i = dates.index('2025-10-20')

piv = df.pivot_table(index=key, columns='date', values='unblended_cost')
prc = df.pivot_table(index=key, columns='date', values='price')
nin = df.pivot_table(index=key, columns='date', values='num_instances')

# windows: pre = up to 10/19, post = 10/20 onward
pre_c = piv[dates[:i]]; post_c = piv[dates[i:]]
rows=[]
for idx in piv.index:
    c = piv.loc[idx]
    p = prc.loc[idx]; n = nin.loc[idx]
    pre = c[dates[:i]]; post = c[dates[i:]]
    rows.append(dict(zip(key, idx)) | {
        'pre_mean':pre.mean(), 'post_mean':post.mean(), 'on':c['2025-10-20'],
        'pre_std':pre.std(), 'post_std':post.std(),
        'price_change': p[dates[:i]].nunique()!=p[dates[i:]].nunique() or p[dates[:i]].mean()!=p[dates[i:]].mean(),
        'n_pre_max': n[dates[:i]].max(), 'n_post_min': n[dates[i:]].min(), 'n_post_max': n[dates[i:]].max(),
        'pre_last7': pre[-7:].mean(), 'on_minus_pre7': c['2025-10-20']-pre[-7:].mean(),
        'post_minus_pre7': post.mean()-pre[-7:].mean(),
    })
r = pd.DataFrame(rows)

import pandas as pd, numpy as np
pd.set_option('display.width', 250)
df = pd.read_csv('data.csv')
key = ['csp','cloud_service','application','instance_family']
dates = sorted(df['date'].unique())
piv = df.pivot_table(index=key, columns='date', values='unblended_cost')

# For each resource, find the single best split point (step change) using mean-shift magnitude vs noise
out=[]
for idx in piv.index:
    c = piv.loc[idx].values.astype(float)
    best=None
    for k in range(14, len(dates)-7):
        a, b = c[:k], c[k:]
        sd = np.sqrt((a.std()**2 + b.std()**2)/2) + 1e-9
        score = abs(b.mean()-a.mean())/sd
        if best is None or score>best[0]:
            best=(score, k, a.mean(), b.mean())
    out.append(dict(zip(key,idx)) | {'score':best[0], 'split_date':dates[best[1]], 'before':best[2], 'after':best[3], 'abs_diff':abs(best[3]-best[2])})
o = pd.DataFrame(out).sort_values('abs_diff', ascending=False)
print(o.head(12).to_string())
print('\nBy score (shift relative to noise):')
print(o.sort_values('score',ascending=False).head(12).to_string())

steps.content:
Root cause analysis complete. Two instance families in account `sBGaYvw` explain the entire cost step:

1. **`GWymgjl2rF`** (AWS / TwUyi / qQw) — price jumped 0.24 → 1.10 (4.58×) exactly on 2025-10-20, which is also its `expiration_date` (commitment/discount expired → on-demand rate). Daily cost went from ~$50 to ~$240 (+$190/day), the dominant driver of the anomaly date.
2. **`wXs6GRnJz0`** (AWS / TwUyi / D4T) — `num_instances` stepped from the usual 7–10 up to a fixed 32 starting 2025-10-13 and stayed there through the anomaly date and beyond; cost went from ~$45 to a flat $172.34/day (+$126/day). Its change began a week before the detection date but persists into it.

Removing just these two resources, the account's daily total is flat (~$5,306 pre vs ~$5,290 post), so no other resource contributes. All other resources show only ordinary day-to-day noise (step-change scores ≈1, diffs of a few dollars vs scores of 10.8 and 32.3 for these two).

2. **`wXs6GRnJz0`** (AWS / TwUyi / D4T) — `num_instances` stepped from the usual 7–10 up to a fixed 32 starting 2025-10-13 and stayed there through the anomaly date and beyond; cost went from ~$45 to a flat $172.34/day (+$126/day).
